### Meaning
| infl. | class  | meaning         |
| ----- | ------ | --------------- |
| ~     | *n.*   | man, male       |
| ~an   | *adj.* | male, masculine |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
(person + hoe) -> person who works the land -> similar to 男
#### Sound
- similar to Japanese reading of 男 (dan)
- *a priori:* d=forceful, a=energy
